items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] It's the one that's got Kid Thomas and Ernie Cagnolite both on trumpet. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. They played it,

ctx.x: It was a record that features Jim Robinson, and I asked you about it, I think, and it's under the Pearl label, and you told me that that was his, named it that because it's his wife's name. That's right. Yeah.
It's the one that's got Kid Thomas and Ernie Cagnolite both on trumpet.
